Definition: to squat or lie out flat, i.e. (specifically) in copulation
BiblicalUsage: 1) to lie stretched out, lie down; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to lie down; 1a1a) for repose; 1a1b) for copulation (of woman with beast); 1b) (Hiphil) to cause to lay down (of cattle breeding)
